newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics forms subsidiary in Japan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics forms subsidiary in Japan.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp, a supplier of modems, handheld organizers and switching equipment, said Wednesday it established a subsidiary in Japan.
The new subsidiary, U.S. Robotics Kabushiki Kaisha, will handle the company's Japanese sales, marketing and support operations for most of its products.

U.S. Robotics said Japan is a key market for the company. Mark Uno, manager of U.S. Robotics Kabushiki Kaisha, noted that five strategic Internet service providers in Japan, including Japan Telecom Co Ltd, have announced they will support the company's x2 technology for downloads at 56 kiloytes per second.
The U.S. Robotics equipment will allow Japan Telecom to offer Points of Presence to Internet service providers who do not wish to invest in locating their own access points throughout Japan.
